items.title: CVS asks federal judge to consolidate four lawsuits challenging Tennessee PBM breakup law - The Business Journals
items.reason: This item reports federal litigation by a major payer (CVS Health) challenging a state law that restricts payer business practices, directly fitting the regulatory enforcement and payer litigation category.
items.summary: CVS Health has asked a federal judge to consolidate four lawsuits challenging Tennessee's PBM (pharmacy benefit manager) breakup law, which restricts how integrated payers can operate their pharmaceutical divisions. The litigation involves CVS's legal challenge to state-level regulation of payer structure and operations. This matters for revenue-cycle teams because pharmacy benefit management disputes directly impact claim processing, drug reimbursement rates, and payer-provider contracting dynamics similar to other payer policy enforcement actions. The outcome could affect how payers manage integrated PBM operations and reimbursement structures across states.
